d:
Established in 2018, CoinDCX is the preferred crypto exchange in India, but also an instrumental player in building the broader Web3 ecosystem. 

Trusted by over 2 crore registered users. Our mission is simple: to provide easy access to Web3 experiences and democratize investments in virtual digital assets. We prioritize user safety and security, strictly adhering to KYC and AML guidelines. 

In our commitment to quality, we employ a stringent 7M Framework for the listing of crypto projects, ensuring users access only the safest virtual digital assets. CoinDCX has partnered with Okto for India to launch a secure multi-chain DeFi app that offers a keyless, self-custody wallet . It aims to simplify the world of decentralized finance (DeFi) by providing a secure, user-friendly, and innovative solution for managing virtual digital assets. 

Through CoinDCX Ventures, we've invested in over 15 innovative Web3 projects, reinforcing our dedication to the Web3 ecosystem. Our flagship educational initiative, #NamasteWeb3, empowers Indians with web3 knowledge, preparing them for the future of virtual digital assets. CoinDCX's vision and potential have gained the confidence of global investors, including Pantera, Steadview Capital, Kingsway, Polychain Capital, B Capital Group, Bain Capital Ventures, Cadenza, Draper Dragon, Republic, Kindred, and Coinbase Ventures. 

At CoinDCX, we're leading India towards the decentralized future of Web3 with an unwavering commitment to safety, simplicity, and education.

In order to ensure that medical devices, equipment and supplies reach sites on time, are installed & calibrated (IQ OQ PQ), site officials are trained on ‘instructions of use’, development of a robust supply chain strategy and management of ancillary supplies at sites for entire duration of life-cycle of a clinical trial is a must but is often undermined which, affects the study timelines.

name: Spice Money
d:
Spice Money is India’s pioneering Rural Fintech company and a key venture under Spice Connect. Spice Money empowers merchants and nanopreneurs, known as Spice Money Adhikaris, through technology to cater to the digital and financial needs of rural citizens. With cutting-edge tech and a wide on-ground network, it is bridging access gaps in essential services and revolutionizing the way Bharat banks.

Spice Money offers essential digital financial and e-retail services such as cash deposit and Aadhaar led withdrawals, mini ATM services, bill payments and recharge, money transfers, loans, tours and travel and more to the rural citizens through Spice Money Adhikari App (available on Google play store with an industry best rating of 4.4) and Web portal.

The Spice Money network, comprising more than 1.3 Million Adhikaris, covers 2,50,000 villages which is more than 18,000 pin codes, 700 districts and 5,000 blocks, serving over 10 crore households. In fact, the network now covers 95% rural pin codes in India.

In December 2020, Spice Money joined hands with actor and philanthropist Sonu Sood with a shared vision of harnessing the power of tech to promote entrepreneurship among the rural and semi-urban population. The company reinvented itself into a new identity – Spice Money to Life Bani encapsulating the brand philosophy of bringing real change in the lives of its customers & Adhikaris. 

Spice Money aims to be the largest Fintech for Good Platform delivering last mile financial & digital services to digitally & financially empower Nanopreneurs in Emerging India. 

We aim to provide much needed access to essential financial services for Rural communities in the remote corners of the country. Spice Money, also has an Open Network for Assisted Digital Distribution platform wherein we can integrate multiple partners and take their services to the last mile with the help of our network of Adhikaris.

Asset Financing, working capital lending, venture debt, equity are some of the funding needs of early stage growth companies in the space, however remains ignored by conventional financiers unless collateral backed. Also, these are too small to be dealt by global investors directly.

d:
Dyson solves real-world problems and creates better products through the application of engineering, science, design and creativity. It is a family-owned, global technology company, founded by Sir James Dyson who remains at the helm alongside his son Jake. 

Since inventing the first cyclonic bagless vacuum cleaner, the DC01, Dyson has consistently invested in research and development to improve its products and technologies radically. Dyson offers products across a growing range of areas: floorcare, air purification, robotics, haircare including formulations, lighting, hand drying, and most recently audio. Dyson continues to expand into new areas.

Today, Dyson sells products in more than 80 markets, has 450 Dyson stores worldwide and is available in all major technology and beauty retailers. Dyson has global headquarters in Singapore and major technology campuses in Singapore, the UK, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global team of engineers, scientists and software developers are focused on developing technology-enabled products which work better and which people love to use. Key areas of focus have included high-speed electric digital motors, sensing and vision systems, robotics, machine learning and aerodynamics. 

Beyond products, to encourage an inventive future, Dyson is also inspiring the next generation of engineers and inventors through the Dyson Institute of Engineering and Technology, the James Dyson Foundation and the James Dyson Award.  

The Dyson family applies its problem-solving approach in other fields, and established Dyson Farming in 2012. It is one of the largest farming businesses in the UK, extending to 36,000 acres across Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire and Somerset. It is a family-owned enterprise unlike any other, focussed on long-term investment in British farming and the countryside to grow tasty and nutritious food.

name: Hostie - Boutique travel homes
d:
Hostie, a journey that started in 2017, with a concept to “Celebrate!”, and what can be better than to make people celebrate special moments and experiences in their life. A zillion smiles, a billion happy faces, and an accomplished commitment soon became the vision of Hostie. Coming from our instincts of perfectionism and hospitality, Hostie has come along to curate, develop and manage unique travel experiences for people to cherish! 

Today, Hostie is that answer to all those travel needs. We operate our boutique travel homes, whether it is for a leisure traveler, or a purpose traveler, a business traveler, or a medical traveler, we understand “why they need our home; that will be their home; when they are traveling”. 

Having serviced more than 30,000 happy customers, in a short span we are always there at service at a Hostie home, to host our traveler’s with the comfort that they have been seeking, the care that they want, the attention that they need, and that satisfaction that they desire.

Our offerings include luxury serviced apartments, palatial farm houses, exquisite mountain homes, and unique vacation homes, that are someone’s second home, and who has trusted Hostie to fully manage and operate their home and share them with like minded traveler’s from across the globe, with the Hostie promise.

We are not an aggregator of homestays or vacation rentals, and we do not intend to be one. When a traveler comes to a Hostie home, they get that experience of handpicked hospitality and a zeal of commitment. We are a team of young as well as young at heart host’s and property partner’s, who want to make a traveler’s trip a memorable lifetime experience. Every house with Hostie, is not just selected on aesthetics, but the passion and commitment of us and our property owner's, that converts that house into “a home”.  

We welcome you to come be a part of this journey with us... We welcome you to Hostie!

Fraud Alert: Beware of Recruitment Scams
We urge all job seekers to be cautious against recruitment scams by unauthorized third parties claiming to act on behalf of “Hilti India Pvt. Ltd.”. These scams can take different forms, such as issuing a fraudulent employment offer letter in the name of “Hilti India Pvt. Ltd.”, and/or soliciting payments from the job seeker during the recruitment process. To verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Hilti, please reach out to us through our official channels. Hilti will never solicit payment from job seekers at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for interviews, job offers, acceptance of offers, or onboarding. Anyone dealing with such unauthorized third parties does so at their own risk.

MX18 was built to remove that guesswork.
We provide email infrastructure that gives teams clear insight into deliverability, IP reputation, and sending behavior — so problems are detected early, not after users complain.
What MX18 helps teams do: 
• Send transactional and product emails with high deliverability 
• Monitor IP reputation and delivery signals in real time 
• Scale from hundreds to millions of emails predictably 
• Get local, human support when delivery actually matters

Email shouldn’t be opaque. We’re building clarity into delivery.
Invisible infrastructure is fragile infrastructure.
Reliable email starts with visibility. We’re building for that.

The company is also developing a transshipment port at Vizhinjam, Kerala, and a container Terminal in Myanmar. 

Our 'Ports to Logistics Platform' comprising our port facilities, integrated logistics capabilities, and industrial economic zones, puts us in a unique position to benefit as India stands to benefit from an impending overhaul in global supply chains. Our vision is to become the world's largest ports and logistics platform over the next decade. With a vision to become carbon-neutral by 2025, APSEZ was the first Indian port and the third in the world to sign up for the Science-Based Targets Initiative (SBTi), committing to emissions-reduction targets to limit global warming to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.

For Job Seekers, we help you find the right career opportunities by connecting you with verified and often exclusive roles. Our team provides personalized support through resume guidance, interview preparation, and career advice to ensure the right long-term fit.

For Employers, we simplify and speed up the hiring process by delivering carefully vetted, job-ready candidates who align with both technical requirements and company culture, allowing teams to hire efficiently and with confidence.

For Referral Partners, we offer a transparent and rewarding referral program. Partners can refer suitable candidates for open roles, while we manage the recruitment process and ensure timely and clear referral payouts.

At The Hiring Company, we are committed to trust, efficiency, and meaningful partnerships that drive growth for individuals and organizations alike.

- Kane CLI: A terminal-native command-line testing agent that verifies what you or coding agents built against requirements in a real browser.
- Agent Testing: Test chatbots, voice assistants, video agents, image analyzer agents, and phone caller agents for hallucinations, bias, and toxicity.
- Agent Assurance: Agentic testing for autonomous AI agents. It reads the agent's code, generates scenarios, and verifies actions through API and database checks.
- Real Device Cloud: Manual and automated testing across 10,000+ real Android and iOS devices.
- HyperExecute: An AI-native test orchestration platform that runs tests up to 70% faster than traditional cloud grids.
- Automation Cloud: Run Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and Appium tests in parallel on 3,000+ browser-OS combinations and real devices.
- SmartUI: AI-native visual regression testing that captures and compares screenshots across browsers, devices, and resolutions, flagging real changes, not noise.
- Accessibility Testing: Identify and resolve WCAG and ADA issues across websites, web apps, and mobile apps.
- Browser Cloud: Browser infrastructure for AI agents: real Chrome sessions on demand for Claude, Cursor, and Gemini.
- Test Management: AI-native test management for manual and automated tests with two-way Jira sync.

Use 120+ integrations like Jira, GitHub, and Slack to accelerate testing across the entire software development lifecycle.

name: Castler
d:
Castler SRP — the world's first AI-assisted Software Escrow and Recoverability Platform.

Traditional software escrow stores source code and hopes it works. It rarely does. The deposit is never rebuilt, never deployed, never proven, and stale by the time you need it. When a critical vendor fails, "we have an escrow agreement" is not the same as being able to recover.

Castler closes that gap. We take your vendor's software, rebuild it from scratch, and prove it runs without the vendor. Every verification is reviewed and signed by a Castler engineer, giving you audit-grade evidence your regulator, board, and risk team can rely on.

The result is a signed Proof of Recovery for each vendor, each release, delivered in 6 to 18 hours instead of weeks, at a fraction of traditional verification cost, across your entire software estate rather than one or two applications.

The regulator has stopped asking "Do you have escrow?" It now asks "Can you prove recovery?" Castler SRP is how you answer, mapped to 17 mandates across 9 jurisdictions including RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI in India, EU DORA, UK PRA SS2/21, MAS TRM, and APRA CPS 230.

Trusted by institutions that cannot afford to be wrong, including HDFC Bank, SBI, Canara Bank, Union Bank, Indian Bank, India Post Payments, NSDL Payments, Pine Labs, and Mahindra Finance.

ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified. Backed by IIFL Fintech Fund, Flipkart Ventures, Rainmatter (Zerodha), Capital2B, and Venture Catalysts.

Dank der Kombination von Pharma und Diagnostika unter einem Dach ist Roche führend in der personalisierten Medizin - einer Strategie mit dem Ziel, jeder Patientin und jedem Patienten die bestmögliche Behandlung zukommen zu lassen.

Roche ist das grösste Biotech-Unternehmen weltweit mit differenzierten Medikamenten für die Onkologie, Immunologie, Infektionskrankheiten, Augenheilkunde und Erkrankungen des Zentralnervensystems. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 1896 erforscht Roche bessere Wege, um Krankheiten zu verhindern, zu erkennen und zu behandeln und leistet einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zur gesellschaftlichen Entwicklung. Zum Ziel des Unternehmens gehört es durch Kooperationen mit allen relevanten Partnern den Zugang von Patienten zu medizinischen Innovationen zu verbessern.

Auf der Liste der unentbehrlichen Arzneimittel der Weltgesundheitsorganisation stehen heute 30 von Roche entwickelte Medikamente, darunter lebensrettende Antibiotika, Malariamittel und Krebsmedikamente. Ausgezeichnet wurde Roche zudem bereits das neunte Jahr in Folge als das nachhaltigste Unternehmen innerhalb der Pharma-, Biotechnologie- und Life-Sciences-Branche im Dow Jones Sustainability Index.

Die Roche-Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Basel, Schweiz ist in über 100 Ländern tätig und beschäftigte 2017 weltweit rund 94 000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter. Im Jahr 2017 investierte Roche CHF 10,4 Milliarden in Forschung und Entwicklung und erzielte einen Umsatz von CHF 53,3 Milliarden. Genentech in den USA gehört vollständig zur Roche-Gruppe. d:
At Saxo we believe that when you invest, you unlock a new curiosity for the world around you. 

Discovering an intuitive desire within to actively learn, explore, and ask questions, you will engage with new companies, new communities, maybe even new countries. You could call this an appetite or passion for new knowledge and skills. We call it curiosity. Ultimately everything we do as a company is focused on getting curious people invested in the world by giving our clients more ways to make more of their money.  

We began in Copenhagen, Denmark in 1992 with a clear vision: to make the global financial markets accessible for more people. In 1998, we launched one of the first online trading platforms in Europe, providing professional-grade tools and easy access to global financial markets for anyone who wanted to invest. 

Today we are a well-capitalised Danish (EU) bank with top capital ratios and positive rating from S&P, trusted by over 850,000 clients. As an international award-winning investment firm for investors and traders who are serious about investing, our clients enjoy regulated and reliable access to over 70,000 financial instruments on our industry-leading platforms. Keeping our headquarters in our beloved Denmark, we have expanded our reach to having more than 72 nationalities employed in offices in 15 countries. 

We are proud of our Scandinavian heritage and we are committed to the values of trust, fairness, and security. We believe this gives our clients the confidence to be adventurous and curious. 
Curiosity can lead you to places you never could have imagined. When you invest, you stimulate the mind, you see new perspectives, and you broaden your horizons. Personal transformation is inevitable as you develop a sincere interest and curiosity for not only the world, but also for others. 

At Saxo our greatest hope is for everyone to become engaged, to feel empowered, and to Be Invested.

Founded by Hiba Khan—a UN-certified Climate Awareness professional, Cyber Security professional, public speaker, Author and sustainability advocate—the Foundation brings together analytical thinking and grassroots action. Hiba’s journey itself sits at an unusual intersection: from Cyber Security and governance to climate education, sustainable living, animal welfare and community initiatives. She is also recognised for her work as India’s first female vegan tabla artist, connecting cultural expression with conversations around compassion and ethical choices. 

Our Five Key Focus Areas
ARANYA - Restore Nature: Afforestation, ecological restoration, tree care, and community participation.
PUNARJEEVAN - Revive Biodiversity: Biodiversity conservation, habitat restoration, wetlands, water systems, and native species.
SAKHI - Empower People: Community well-being, dignity, inclusion, and empowerment.
CLIMATE LEADERSHIP - Enable Action: Climate literacy, sustainable living, behavioural change, and institutional environmental action.
PRAGYA - Knowledge for Change: Using books, ideas, and public dialogue to connect environmental action with community well-being, ethical living, and social change.

The Foundation has reached 35 lakh+ individuals through leaderhsip initiatives across academic institutions, corporate forums, community platforms and digital media.

But numbers are only one part of the journey.

Our Vision: To build a conscious, compassionate, and environmentally resilient India by transforming awareness into action and action into impact.

d:
CliniEdge is a cutting-edge clinical resource platform that revolutionizes healthcare practices by empowering healthcare professionals with the tools they need for better clinical decision-making and ultimately improving patient outcomes. As a comprehensive solution, CliniEdge caters to the diverse needs of medical professionals, academic institutions, research organizations, and pharmaceutical companies.

At its core, CliniEdge strives to enhance the quality of healthcare by providing an extensive library of up-to-date and relevant medical content. d:
AIS is India’s leading integrated glass solutions company and a dominant player in the car glass segment commanding over 75% of the Indian market. Established in 1987, AIS has grown from being a ‘single product, single customer’ company to a world-class integrated company with 13 plants/sub-assembly units and global customers, offering a comprehensive range of products and solutions ranging from Clear & Tinted, to Reflective, Processed, Frosted and Lacquered Glass to Glass Consultation, Installation and Service.

AIS has three Strategic Business Units (SBUs):

• Automotive Glass
• Architectural Glass
• Consumer Glass

AIS is driven to market-leading innovations providing the right blend between daylight and energy saving, visual comfort and thermal comfort, technology and sensitivity, enabling an age of Green Buildings and the dawn of a truly sustainable future. Standing tall, AIS is a world-class integrated glass company listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange with around 60,000 shareholders. AIS is jointly promoted by the Labroo family, Asahi Glass Co. Ltd. (AGC) and Maruti Suzuki India Ltd. (MSIL).

Also for automotive glasses AIS has started Windshield Experts, India’s first and only specialist in automotive glass repair and replacement. Windshield Experts provide fast, world – class guaranteed service at an affordable price to customers and follows international safety standards for car glass repair and replacement.

Today, AIS - India’s leading glass manufacturer, is driven to market-leading innovations providing the right blend between daylight and energy saving, visual and thermal comfort, technology and sensitivity, along with state of the art glass manufacturing plants. AIS enables an age of Green Buildings and supporting a truly sustainable future.

name: Ugaoo
d:
At Ugaoo, we are on a mission to bring nature back into our everyday spaces. 

We believe that gardening should be a joyful, effortless experience rather than one requiring endless guesswork or extreme dedication. 

That is why our core philosophy is simple: Plant Parenting Made Easy.

As a leading brand in India's gardening sector, we are intentionally making gardening convenient and accessible for everyone. Cultivated across our 25-acre farm in Talegaon and five state-of-the-art poly-hubs across India, we deliver premium, healthy plants directly from our farms to your doorstep.

We currently have 23 offline stores across Pune, Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Nashik, bringing Ugaoo closer to plant parents across India. 

We further support your gardening journey with smart self-watering planters, expert-formulated soil mixes, and an industry-first 30-Day Replacement Guarantee designed to give you complete confidence and peace of mind as your green family grows.

Backed by DSG Consumer Partners, V3 Ventures, RPG Ventures, and Cropnosys, Ugaoo's vision and mission are spearheaded by our Founder and CEO, Siddhant Bhalinge, alongside a deeply passionate team of "plant paglus" who live and breathe all things green. 

Whether you're bringing home your first desk plant, nurturing a beautiful balcony garden, or landscaping a space, Ugaoo provides the infrastructure, knowledge, and tools to ensure a successful and rewarding plant parenting journey.

Visit our website to explore our collection. Happy Plant Parenting :)

name: Primebook
d:
What happens when deep-tech meets the everyday ambitions of the youth? You get Primebook, a full-stack personal computing ecosystem bringing together purpose-built hardware, OS, in-built apps and value-added services into a vertically integrated platform.

A product of Floydwiz Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Primebook’s deep-tech journey began in 2018 with a mission to redefine personal computing for Young India from the ground up.

Founded by two IIT Delhi alumni, Aman Verma and Chitranshu Mahant, and backed by Shark Tank India, Primebook is built for students, self-learners, creators, coders and developers, freelancers and young professionals.

At the centre of the ecosystem is PrimeOS, our proprietary operating system built on Android exclusively for Primebook laptops. It brings Android to a laptop-first computing experience, with access to:

- PrimeOffice, our free, offline-first office suite
- PrimeLinux, with select Linux apps and a Linux terminal
- PrimeAGNT, the Operator AI that executes tasks across apps and the web
- Prime App Store, with a vast library of Android apps
- Keymapping for mobile-first apps and games
- Task Manager and PrimeSecurity for device health, app management and security
- PrimeX Cloud PC, enabling access to virtual Windows and Linux environments

The ecosystem has grown, and so has the recognition around it. Primebook has been recognised by DeviceNext, Flipkart, Amazon, Startup Mahakumbh, Kyoorius, Social Samosa and Local Samosa. Recent recognitions include Indian Computing Innovation Brand of the Year at the DeviceNext Brand Awards 2026, DeepTech Startup of the Year at Startup Mahakumbh 5.0, and Experience & Activation Winner at the Kyoorius Creative Awards 2026.

Today, Primebook has 100K+ users across India, 300+ CSR partnerships and a presence across leading e-commerce marketplaces and 300+ retail stores.

But honestly? We’re just getting started. And we’re not here to play it safe.

Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL), a part of the Aditya Birla Group, is a leading branded apparel company with a comprehensive portfolio of marquee lifestyle brands.

As of March 31, 2025, the Company operates a retail footprint of over 4.6 million sq. ft., comprising 3,253 exclusive brand outlets, presence across 38,000+ multi-brand outlets, and over 7,000 shop-in-shops in department stores across the country.

The Company’s brand portfolio includes India’s most established and trusted names – Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, and Peter England – each with a legacy of over 25 years.

These brands have consistently delivered sustained growth, driven by a sharp focus on design-led innovation, category expansion, and operational excellence across product lines spanning formal, casual, and occasion wear.

ABLBL has built a strong presence in the innerwear and athleisure market through Van Heusen Innerwear, which has rapidly scaled its distribution network across India. The Company’s portfolio is further enhanced through strategic partnerships with leading international brands including Simon Carter, American Eagle and Reebok. American Eagle has emerged as one of India’s most preferred premium denim brands, while Reebok – transitioned under the Company’s management in 2022 – has expanded its footprint across multiple channels. The network operates some of India’s top news channels such as CNN-News18 (English), News18 India (Hindi), CNBC-TV18 (English) & CNBC Awaaz (Hindi). The regional portfolio of the news network boasts 15 channels such as News18 Uttar Pradesh / Uttarakhand, News18 Bihar / Jharkhand, News18 Madhya Pradesh / Chhattisgarh, News18 Rajasthan, News18 Punjab, News18 J&K / Ladakh / Himachal / Haryana, News18 Assam/NE, News18 Gujarati, News18 Bangla, News18 Odia, News18 Kerala, News18 Kannada, News18 Tamil Nadu, News18 Lokmat and CNBC Bajar.

It also is home to India’s most visited news websites such as News18.com, CNBCTV18.com, Moneycontrol.com, firstpost.com among others. Network18’s latest initiative Local18 (which focuses on hyperlocal content) covers almost 300 districts in India.

The group also publishes Forbes in India.

name: Judge India Solutions
d:
Judge India Solutions is an IT, Learning & Talent Solutions provider that empowers organizations by harnessing innovation and improving business scalability. With ‘Transformation & Beyond’ as our motto, we become the catalyst to bring greater efficiencies through our technology-driven models and deliver capabilities beyond your sight.

With delivery centers located in Noida, Bangalore, and Hyderabad, we aim to make your business future-ready with the help of our Hardware Design & Engineering Solutions, ServiceNow Solutions, SAP Solutions, AI-ML-RPA Solutions, Cloud Solutions, Technology Solutions, Learning Solutions, e-Governance Solutions, Talent Solutions, and Global Managed Services. Whether it is moving your systems to the cloud, building out a team for your next mission-critical project, or creating reliable virtual environments powered by high-tech modern technologies, we deliver solutions tailored to your needs to ensure your organization’s long-term growth and sustainability. Our revolutionary and cutting-edge facilities enable us to seamlessly deliver services to clients around the clock and across the globe.

Judge India Solutions is a 100% subsidiary of The Judge Group and was established in 2016 as a key element of their global delivery strategy. The Judge Group is a privately-owned, leading professional services firm with 50+ years of experience in providing immaculate business solutions. With a powerful workforce of 10,000 employees, it caters to clients through a network of more than 30+ offices across the United States, Canada, Europe, and India, and serves more than 60 Fortune 100 companies across a wide range of industries.

name: Niyama Immigration LLP
d:
1. At Niyama Immigration, we pride ourselves on working with experienced immigration advisors and registered migration agents who are committed to making your dreams come true. We fully understand that we have a huge responsibility to meet and exceed our clients’ expectations.

2. We go to great lengths to ensure that your visa application is completed accurately and on time. Our team takes complete responsibility and accountability for your visa application, and we do our best to ensure a positive outcome.

3. We work with ICCRC registered migration agents for Canada and MARA registered agents for Australia. Our registered migration agents are well-versed with immigration laws and provide the right guidance to help you fulfil your immigration goals.

4. Every client is different, and so are their individual needs. We take extra care to understand our clients’ needs to provide a personalized immigration solution for their unique needs.

5. We firmly believe in transparency and provide complete information regarding the whole visa process. Whether it is visa eligibility, process, or documentation, with Niyama Immigration, you are assured of complete transparency throughout the whole process.

name: DMI Finance Private Limited
d:
DMI Finance is a tech-driven, new-thinking provider of credit solutions to a heterogeneous portfolio of corporate borrowers across India. As a credit partner to growing Indian companies, we offer everything from short-term bridge financing and medium-term project financing to term loans and working capital loans. We also support select fintech companies as a balance sheet partner, leveraging the vast consumer finance universe in India through these tie-ups, effectively working around entry barriers in the space.

Founded in 2008 by Shivashish Chatterjee and Yuvraja C. Singh, DMI Finance is headquartered in Delhi, with corporate offices in Mumbai and Bangalore and branch offices pan-India. The company has also acquired a Housing Finance Company license, a Merchant Banking license and registered an Alternate Investment Fund.
